title: Precision mapping of NF-kappaB-DNA binding: high-resolution insights via dynamic UV-laser footprinting.
authors: Lone, Imtiaz Nisar; Cavdar, Gozdem; Peshev, Zahari; Kale, Seyit; Angelov, Dimitar
one_liner_zh: 该文结合动态UV激光足迹实验与全原子分子动力学模拟，高分辨率解析NF-kappaB转录因子与DNA的特异性结合动力学及侧翼序列调控机制，高度契合TF-DNA互作建模课题。
abstract: Sequence-specific binding is at the core of all DNA-templated processes, including the initiation of DNA replication, gene expression and DNA repair. Yet the kinetics and precision of these interactions remain difficult to capture at high resolution. Here, we present Dynamic UV Laser Footprinting (DULF), a novel technique that integrates UV laser footprinting with stopped-flow mixing to probe transcription factor (TF)-DNA interactions at millisecond temporal and single base-pair spatial resolution. Using NF-kappaB as a model TF, we demonstrate the feasibility of DULF in visualizing the spatiotemporal details of a sequence-specific TF-DNA interaction. The high temporal resolution of our data reveals that TF-DNA binding proceeds through a rapid recognition step and a subsequent slower stabilization phase. DULF also revealed that the p50 homodimer binds specifically to DNA outside the canonical binding site, emphasizing the role of flanking sequences in these interactions. All-atom molecular dynamics simulations confirmed that DNA sequence context, including flanking base pairs, modulates NF-kappaB binding stability and induces local structural changes such as bending, groove widening, and base unstacking. DULF offers a unique opportunity to study DNA-protein interactions at unprecedented resolution, providing insights into the mechanism of sequence-specific binding and stabilization of chromatin interactors.
abstract_zh: 序列特异性结合是所有DNA模板化过程的核心，包括DNA复制起始、基因表达和DNA修复。然而，这些相互作用的动力学和精确性在高分辨率下仍难以捕捉。在此，我们提出动态紫外激光足迹法（Dynamic UV Laser Footprinting, DULF），一种将紫外激光足迹法与停流混合相结合的新技术，用于在毫秒级时间分辨率和单碱基对空间分辨率下探测转录因子（transcription factor, TF）-DNA相互作用。以NF-kappaB作为模型TF，我们证明了DULF在可视化序列特异性TF-DNA相互作用的时空细节方面的可行性。我们数据的高时间分辨率揭示，TF-DNA结合通过一个快速识别步骤和随后的较慢稳定阶段进行。DULF还揭示，p50同源二聚体在经典结合位点之外特异性结合DNA，强调了侧翼序列在这些相互作用中的作用。全原子分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟证实，DNA序列背景（包括侧翼碱基对）调节NF-kappaB结合稳定性，并诱导局部结构变化，如弯曲、沟槽加宽和碱基去堆积。DULF为以前所未有的分辨率研究DNA-蛋白质相互作用提供了独特机会，为序列特异性结合和染色质相互作用因子稳定的机制提供了见解。
